It added the countdown for the 2025 Halloween event. This update encompassed thirteen versions, the main v1.76.0 version (released 1 October 2025) and twelve minor updates, the v1.76.0a (released 1 October 2025), v1.76.0b (released 1 October 2025), *[[Halloween 2025 Live Events]] :In '''v1.76.4b''': *[[Nil Zone]] *[[Halloween 2025 Live Events]] ==Changes & Bugfixes== *[[Jester]] is now purchasable through a gamepass for {{Robux|749}}. *[[Playtime Rewards]] changed. **Time required to get each chest nerfed. ***Second reward increased from 10 minutes to 15 minutes. ***Third reward increased from 20 minutes to 30 minutes. ***Fourth reward increased from 30 minutes to 60 minutes. ***Fifth reward increased from 45 minutes to 90 minutes. ***Sixth reward increased from 60 minutes to 120 minutes. **Chest icons are now bigger. **The reward pool list is now displayed when hovered over instead of requiring the player to click the magnifying glass. **New animation for displaying gained rewards. *Updated news icon. *Updated [[Limitation Makes Creativity]] modifier description. *Corrected [[Limitation Makes Creativity]] trial incorrectly saying it sets the placement limit to 20 but removed individual tower placement limits. *Fixed [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode not allowing players to equip or unequip towers. *Fixed {{Color|Unobtainable|Witch}} [[Medic]] being shirtless at Level 4-5. *Fixed the cross on the [[Coffin]] appearing in the air. :In '''v1.76.0a''': *Enabled [[Random Tower Positions]] on all maps. :In '''v1.76.0b''': *Disabled [[Random Tower Positions]] on all maps. :In '''v1.76.1''': *Fixed issues with [[PVP]] [[Matchmaking]]. :In '''v1.76.2''': *Event area now has a [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] pedestal which has a twitching body on it. This body may fall into the void after a while. :In '''v1.76.2a''': *[[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] pedestal removed. :In '''v1.76.2c''': *Fixed opening audio not playing prior to the players being teleported to the [[Nil Zone]]. **As this fix would be impossible to experience, the [[October 4 Live Event]] opening animation was rerun few minutes after the fix. :In '''v1.76.3''': *Various game optimizations added. *[[Corrupted Wraith]] health decreased from 100 to 85. *[[Corrupted Revenant]] health decreased from 600 to 500. *[[Corrupted Terror]] health decreased from 8,500 to 7,500. *[[Corrupted Horror]] health decreased from 1,200 to 1,000. *[[Corrupted Blight Walker]] health decreased from 1,500 to 1,250. *[[Eclipsed (Nil Zone)|Eclipsed]] health increased from 3,000 to 3,500. *[[Executioner (Pizza Party)|Executioner]] [[Shield Health]] decreased from 65,000 to 55,000. *[[Actor1 (Nil Zone)|Actor1]] health decreased from 3,000 to 2,500. *[[Actor2 (Nil Zone)|Actor2]] health decreased from 10,000 to 8,000. *[[Actor3 (Nil Zone)|Actor3]] health decreased from 20,000 to 17,000. *Fixed [[Unknown Boss]] only summoning the [[Unknown Small]] when it has [[Corpse (Attribute)|Corpse]]. *Fixed [[Unknown Small]] having no health in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. *[[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] enemies no longer have wavering translucency. :In '''v1.76.4''':
